Currently it never happens that a netdevice that is already a bridge slave
would suddenly become mlxsw upper. The only case where this might be
possible as far as mlxsw is concerned
column2: is with LAG netdevices. But if a LAG

column1: already has an upper
column2: enslaving mlxsw port to that LAG is forbidden. Thus

column1: the only way to install a LAG between a bridge and a mlxsw port is by first
enslaving the port to the LAG
column2: and then enslaving that LAG to a bridge.

column1: However in the following patches
column2: the requirement that ports be only

column1: enslaved to masters without uppers
column2: is going to be relaxed. It will

column1: therefore be necessary to join bridges of LAG uppers. Without this replay
the mlxsw bridge_port objects are not instantiated
later
column2: as a lot of code relies on their presence.

column1: Therefore in this patch
column2: when the first mlxsw physical netdevice is

column1: enslaved to a LAG
column2: consider bridges upper to the LAG (both the direct

column1: master
column3: and any bridge masters of VLAN uppers)

column1: relevant netdevices join their bridges.
